passage.quote: Underlined passages connect the explanation to more detail. A passage with one destination opens it directly: a linked description replaces the current description, while linked source appears beside it. When a passage has several destinations, the side pane lets the reader choose which one to follow.

from.quote: The reader combines explicit metadata links with child descriptions anchored to the current prose. It resolves each anchor to a range in the description. When links overlap, the text is divided at their boundaries so clicking a segment offers the destinations that actually cover that segment, rather than every link in the paragraph.
